atoms.b: Describes a person's rise from a state of extreme poverty to one of great wealth.

A foundational phrase from the Declaration of Independence, asserting that all people are born with inherent rights (Life, Liberty, pursuit of Happiness) and are political equals, though its application historically excluded many groups.
Belief that anyone in the USA, regardless of background, can achieve success, prosperity, and upward mobility through hard work and determination.
Presents the American Dream as a myth, whose promises often remain unfulfilled and are replaced by poverty, injustice, systemic barriers, racism, and social separation.
A social system in which people gain success or power because of their abilities, not because of their money or social position.
